content.content: Locate and service ABC extinguishers and a galley fire blanket. Mount within easy reach and check gauges/dates.

content: Place one at galley, one near companionway, one aft cabin/engine space
Monthly gauge check; shake dry chemical units to prevent caking
Train crew on PASS and blanket smother technique

sideB.content: Locate and service ABC extinguishers and a galley fire blanket. Mount within easy reach and check gauges/dates.

content.content: Propane demands vigilance: test solenoid operation, leak-check lines, and confirm detector/sniffer alarms.

content: Sniffer test and alarm verification before cooking
Close cylinder valve when not in use
Inspect locker drains and regulator for corrosion

sideB.content: Propane demands vigilance: test solenoid operation, leak-check lines, and confirm detector/sniffer alarms.

content.content: Label circuits, keep a clean panel, and know how to isolate faults quickly with mains and sub-breakers.

content: Spare fuses taped inside panel door
Document normal operating currents
Train crew: 'shore/off/gen' selector and inverter

sideB.content: Label circuits, keep a clean panel, and know how to isolate faults quickly with mains and sub-breakers.

content.content: Inspect hold-downs, venting, and cabling. Know where the master switch is and when to use it.

content: Tight, corrosion-free terminals with strain relief
Correct venting/clearances per battery type
Post a one-line diagram near the switch

sideB.content: Inspect hold-downs, venting, and cabling. Know where the master switch is and when to use it.

content.content: Fit and test carbon monoxide, smoke, and propane detectors. Replace sensors per manufacturer intervals.

content: Monthly test and annual battery replacement
Mount CO detectors at berth height
Log test dates on a sticker

sideB.content: Fit and test carbon monoxide, smoke, and propane detectors. Replace sensors per manufacturer intervals.

content.content: Fast water removal saves boats. Keep access clear and pumps operational (automatic & manual).

content: Test float switches and high-water alarm
Clean strainers; backflush discharge lines
Stow a large manual pump and bucket

sideA.content: What are the key points of 'Bilge Access & Pumps'?

sideB.content: Fast water removal saves boats. Keep access clear and pumps operational (automatic & manual).

content.content: Every crew should know where to find and operate each seacock under the sole and in lockers.

content: Color-code handles and hang tapered plugs on lanyards
Exercise quarterly; lube per valve type
Post a laminated map at nav station

sideB.content: Every crew should know where to find and operate each seacock under the sole and in lockers.

content.content: Stock to the voyage profile. Make contents accessible and labeled, with med guides handy.

content: Gloves, CPR mask, trauma supplies, seasickness meds
Waterproof inventory sheet with expiry dates
Train crew: basic first aid & comms plan

sideB.content: Stock to the voyage profile. Make contents accessible and labeled, with med guides handy.

content.content: Marine toilet basics, conserve water, safe galley use when heeled, stowage & cleanup.
Ensure hatches/ports open freely from inside and are not obstructed by stowage or add-ons.

content: Test latches and keep a safety knife nearby
Anti-rattle mods must not jam egress
Keep bug screens removable in seconds

sideA.content: What are the key points of 'Emergency Egress: Hatches & Ports'?

sideB.content: Ensure hatches/ports open freely from inside and are not obstructed by stowage or add-ons.

content.content: Quiet, reliable water delivery depends on secure hoses, accumulator pressure, and clean filters.

content: Set accumulator to ~2 psi below cut-in
Sanitize tanks periodically
Carry spare pump head & strainer

sideB.content: Quiet, reliable water delivery depends on secure hoses, accumulator pressure, and clean filters.

content.content: Keep odors and failures at bay with correct hose routing, venting, and disciplined use.

content: Exercise Y-valve; lock when required by law
Vent line clear; charcoal filter service
Use bio treatments compatible with hoses

sideB.content: Keep odors and failures at bay with correct hose routing, venting, and disciplined use.

content.content: Safe heat and airflow reduce moisture and mold. Inspect heaters, ducts, fans, and CO risk.

Run dehumidifier/vent fans when idle

sideB.content: Safe heat and airflow reduce moisture and mold. Inspect heaters, ducts, fans, and CO risk.

content.content: A tidy toolkit speeds fixes underway. Standardize fasteners and label kits.

content: Spare belts, filters, impellers, hose, clamps, wire

sideB.content: A tidy toolkit speeds fixes underway. Standardize fasteners and label kits.

sideB.content: Good lighting prevents injury and preserves night vision. Plan red/white modes and task lights.
